svg.title: Printer judgments, batch predictions and action sensitivity
svg.desc: Three panels retain fictional packets A0, B0 and revised B1. The first shows fitted Beta CDFs and their elicited points. The second shows predictive probabilities for 0 through 20 usable labels, with fewer than 16 marked as a shortfall. The third shows expected print loss as the shortfall penalty varies, against outsourcing at 15 cost units. At penalty 25, A0 selects print with loss 12.449; B0 and B1 select outsource, with print losses 24.092 and 18.714. Line styles and markers distinguish packets as well as color. No packet is a measured expert opinion.
